title: Lesson 24: Multi-Agent Systems: Orchestrator-Worker, Supervisor, and Debate
description: Lesson 23 taught you the single-agent patterns. This lesson puts several agents in one system. You learn the three coordination shapes that dominate real multi-agent work: orchestrator-worker (a central agent splits and delegates), supervisor (a coordinator routes to specialized workers via handoffs), and debate (multiple instances argue toward a consensus), plus when each one earns its complexity and when one agent is still the right call.
